Finding love can be tough, especially when you’re on a competition show. Backs are stabbed and lines are crossed, leaving love as a last priority, but what happens when the reality show is taken out of the equation?

The Love Island USA spinoff Love Island: Beyond the Villa answers that question and so much more, following some fan-favorite contestants from previous seasons as they navigate real life outside of that iconic villa. The second season of the show returns on Wednesday, April 15, with new episodes airing weekly at 6 p.m. PT/9 p.m. ET on Peacock .

Below, learn how you can tune in to Love Island: Beyond the Villa for free on Peacock .

How to Watch Peacock Online for Free

You can watch Love Island: Beyond the Villa via Peacock’s Select, Premium and Premium Plus subscriptions . The bad news? Peacock does not currently offer a free trial for its subscription tiers. The good news? We’ve found a few easy workarounds that could save you time and money in the long run. First, you can get a Premium Plus subscription with ads, which would normally run users $16.99 a month, for free by signing up with Walmart+ .

This season, the Love Island: Beyond the Villa cast includes Amaya Espinal, Andreina Santos, Belle-A Walker, Bryan Arenales, Chris Seeley, Clarke Carraway and Coco Watson. Love Island USA , hosted by reality star Ariana Madix, is currently on its eighth season. The new season will premiere on June 2, also on Peacock.
